structure: Single high school course. Header gives 'Grade/Course: American Problems / ACCN: CGU2200'. Pages are series of small tables: Strand (American Problems) + Standard heading: 'Standard N: ...'; per benchmark a table with Topic, benchmark text and code (Benchmark SS.AP.n.m), Sample Performance (example task), 'Assessment (SPA)' and a 4-level Rubric (Advanced/Proficient/Partially Proficient/Novice in C1-C4). Rubric sentences sometimes split across page breaks.
issues: Rubric rows and 'Assessment (SPA)' labels labeled backup as assessment material; 'Sample Performance' tasks labeled examples.
Course has no stated grade; assigned 9-12.
u179-u186: rubric row split across page break (backup).
u56-u58: benchmark text SS.AP.1.4 starts on page 2 after the Topic cell on page 1 (standards).
